name: Mini Beef Meatloaves with Garlicky Mashed Parsnips & Mixed Green Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Place ketchup, water, Worcestershire, and sugar in a small bowl, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup ketchup
2 tbsp water
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Place in a large bowl along with beef, eggs, bread crumbs, additional ketchup, and spices; mix with your hands until the meatloaf mixture is well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1.02 kg lean ground beef
3 eggs
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
2 tbsp ketchup
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Form the meatloaf mixture into 18 short, sausage-like shapes, approximately 3-inches long. Transfer to the baking sheet.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until meatloaves are cooked through, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
12 medium parsnips
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice parsnips; peel garlic. Place both in a large pot and cover with hot water (from the tap). Cover and bring to a boil over high heat; once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook until soft, 12-15 minutes.
While the parsnips are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
When the parsnips are done, drain in a colander and return to the pot. Add milk, salt, and pepper, then using a potato masher, mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
177 ml whole milk
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide mashed parsnips, meatloaves, and salad between plates. Top meatloaves with sauce and enjoy!
